basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Non Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Clinical Psychologist, MO and More Posts
basic_details.organization_name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Mangalagiri (AIIMS)

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 35 years Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

qualification.education_qualification: M.A./M.Sc in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology and 2 years experience for Clinical Psychologist; Degree in AYUSH with enrollment and 3 years experience for Medical Officer (AYUSH); M.Sc in Nuclear Medicine and AERB certification for Medical Physicist (Nuclear Medicine).
qualification.details: Clinical Psychologist: M.A. / M.Sc in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology and at least 2 years' experience in Clinical Psychology. Medical Officer (AYUSH): A degree in relevant stream of AYUSH from a Recognised University / Statutory State Board / Council / Faculty of Indian Medicine or equivalent recognized under the relevant council. Enrolment on the Central Register of that stream in Central or State Register of Indian Medicine. 3 years clinical and/or teaching experience in a recognized hospital/teaching institution. Medical Physicist (Nuclear Medicine): M.Sc in Nuclear Medicine from a recognized University/Institution and RSO level-II Certification recognized by AERB.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Non-Faculty Group-A posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Non-Faculty Group-A posts is 04-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for AIIMS Mangalagiri recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Non-Faculty Group-A posts at AIIMS Mangalagiri.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the Non-Faculty Group-A posts is 21 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the AIIMS Mangalagiri recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the AIIMS Mangalagiri recruitment is 35 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for UR category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for UR, OBC, and EWS category candidates is Rs. 1500.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any application fee exemptions?
faq.answer: Yes, Persons with Disabilities are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be appointed at Pay Level-10 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q8. What are the different posts advertised by AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: AIIMS Mangalagiri has advertised for the posts of Clinical Psychologist, Medical Officer (AYUSH), and Medical Physicist (Nuclear Medicine).

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official AIIMS Mangalagiri website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these Non-Faculty Group-A posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Interview, and a Screening Test may be conducted if deemed necessary.
